decisions: A shared synthetic fixture module provides four stable topics over eight contiguous monthly periods: a smooth monotonic ramp (quantum), the same ramp lagged by one period (cooling), a flat control (robotics) and a single-period spike (solid).
Fixture tests verify internal alignment invariants (sorted unique periods, cooling == quantum shifted by one) instead of re-deriving the fixture from itself.
Store roundtrip reconstructs TopicObservation from explicit row fields because list_observations exposes the obs_id surrogate key that the contract does not carry.
Change-point expectations follow the two-window semantics: the first candidate period is window+1 (index 2) because earlier periods lack a full before-window.
S-curve r_squared threshold set to >0.8 reflecting the explainable logit approximation over the synthetic ramp, not a fitted-by-construction guarantee.
risks: Synthetic fixtures validate deterministic semantics, not production-scale volume or irregular real periods.
Fixture frequencies are integer counts; fractional or missing-period series remain uncovered.
